_note: EMBEDDED dependency spec — the checksum trust anchor (ships inside the code-signed installer). Windows-first; macOS keeps bundling this slice, so no macOS entries yet (the schema supports platform:'macos' for later adoption). PHASE 0 (PARTIAL): the CPU engine + FFmpeg are LIVE — hosted on the public GitHub repo GarniczAndrzej/reel-automator-deps (release deps-v1.0.0) with real pinned SHA-256. ALIGN MODELS ARE NOT A MANAGED DEPENDENCY: the wav2vec2 align model is no longer downloaded/staged via this spec — the engine pulls it from the OFFICIAL HuggingFace repo (jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-polish) into the default HF cache at first transcription (see whisper.rs: HF-offline is only forced when a local align dir is present). STILL STUBBED: the GPU engine (`engine-gpu-windows-x86_64`) keeps a placeholder RELEASE_HOST url + empty sha256 because the 3.3 GB artifact exceeds GitHub's 2 GB per-asset cap — it needs a no-cap host (e.g. HuggingFace) before it can be pinned. An empty sha256 means 'not yet pinned' → the Phase 2 downloader fail-closes and REFUSES to stage that artifact (safe default). On a GPU machine, force the CPU variant (UI override / REEL_ENGINE_VARIANT=cpu) to exercise the live download path until the GPU host is chosen. To pin a new artifact: upload at its versioned URL, compute SHA-256 (`Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256` / `sha256sum`), replace `url` + `sha256` (+ verify `sizeBytes`).
